crossRefs.note: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses…
Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law…
So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy…

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
translations.bsb: Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop.
translations.kjv: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
translations.asv: And be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mount.
